## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%) ABOVE TREND show equity strength while XLF (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.33%) BELOW TREND and mixed sector returns keep the regime neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit steady: HYG (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.63% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND → flat. Cyclical demand rising: CPER (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND ↑; fear subdued: VXX (1W: -0.70% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.71%) RECOVERY → flat, UUP and yield-curve metrics show no clear drift, and HYG/LQD steady (both ABOVE TREND).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND; Financials lag: XLF (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -0.33%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum showing relative strength versus Value.

5. US vs Global?  
US strong: SPY (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +16.73%) ABOVE TREND; Emerging Markets also robust: EEM (1W: +5.91% | 1M: +12.10%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +3.37%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Healthy speculative flows: IWM (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +15.50%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +11.81%) ABOVE TREND — risk assets broadly embraced.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base/industrial metals strong: CPER (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +18.29% | 1M: +12.91%) ABOVE TREND; Gold in RECOVERY: GLD (1W: +4.81% | 1M: -0.57%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under short-term pressure with mixed medium-term: XLE (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -8.50% | 1M: +16.44%) CORRECTION, while natural gas UNG (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +4.18%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Technology and broad equities (XLK, QQQ, SPY) both timeframes positive (ABOVE TREND). Divergences: multiple commodity/energy ETFs in CORRECTION (UGA, BNO, USO) and TLT/GLD in RECOVERY create MINOR divergence across assets, keeping conviction in check.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure: XLK (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +16.73%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to Energy XLE (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION and Utilities XLU (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -3.88%) BELOW TREND, and monitor TLT/GLD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72%) ABOVE TREND — favor exposure; SOXX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -2.65% | 1M: -3.88%) BELOW TREND — reduce exposure.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +10.71% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +18.29% | 1M: +12.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: BNO (1W: -8.50% | 1M: +16.44%) CORRECTION and UGA (1W: -3.26% | 1M: +22.91%) CORRECTION — watch for profit-taking reversals.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ratio 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), CPER 1M returns sustaining >+8% (cyclical momentum).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive supports a balanced stance with mixed leadership. Technology and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK 1W: +9.77% | 1M: +24.72% ABOVE TREND; SOXX 1W: +15.30% | 1M: +37.81% ABOVE TREND) while Energy and Utilities show weakness (XLE 1W: -3.74% | 1M: +0.40% CORRECTION; XLU 1W: -2.65% | 1M: -3.88% BELOW TREND), monitor commodity corrections and TLT/GLD divergences.
